Convert an analysis manifest to a data.frame

Source: R/cpas_manifest.R
as.data.frame.cpas_manifest.Rd

Flattens the manifest into a two-column field/value table so it can be written to CSV, compared between runs, or embedded in a report. Table-valued fields are collapsed into one row each; the structured tables remain in the manifest itself ($pooling_table, $dropped_rows, $dropped_covariates, $overlap_pairs).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cpas_manifest'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class cpas_manifest.

row.names, optional, ...

Passed to as.data.frame for compatibility.

Value

data.frame with columns field and value.
